scope: Actual product output from three fourth-attempt runs: real Hao Claude SDK and product HTTP/PostgreSQL with controlled Exa-shaped source responses. No real Exa/TikHub network integration or GET-9-wide acceptance is claimed.
reviewedSurface: Original fixture image, tool records, persisted output summary/findings/profile fields and source references. Hidden SDK final prose is not substituted for product copy. No rendered Web/iOS screenshots were reviewed in this scoring pass.

reasons.task_completion: Filed the three extracted messages and produced current-role and historical-background fields with source references; the namesake was excluded and no external effect was recorded.
reasons.grounding: Current LatticeWorks and 2022 Orbit Labs information remain distinct and source-linked. The no-action finding correctly attributes the acknowledgement to our side. The summary phrase 查证 is stronger than the controlled-source and unconfirmed-state boundary; limitations disclose that boundary. This is minor wording friction, not an observed confirmed-state overwrite.
reasons.naturalness: The visible summary answers the requested current/history/namesake questions, but is dense and repeats the injection discussion and caveats elsewhere in the card.
reasons.recovery: An actual CONTACT_UNDERSTANDING_REQUIRED error was followed by record_screenshot_understanding, corrected search and successful filing/research completion. No injected provider outage occurred in this trial.

reasons.task_completion: The requested filing and sourced current/history/namesake research completed, but a saved no-action finding requires correction of its speaker.
reasons.grounding: The m3 finding says 对方仅表示确认收到信息, while the original image explicitly labels the right-side acknowledgement 我 and the extraction records speaker_side=right. This reverses the actor and misstates the relationship evidence. Public-source identity and temporal distinctions otherwise match the fixture.
reasons.naturalness: The primary research summary is understandable but dense. The actor error is scored under grounding; repeated test-source caveats add minor friction.
reasons.recovery: Actual CONTACT_TOOL_NOT_AUTHORIZED and CONTACT_PUBLIC_QUERY_NOT_IDENTITY_ONLY denials were followed by an authorized identity-only search, successful fetches, update and finish. The rejected extra filing call did not duplicate storage.

reasons.task_completion: Filing and sourced research completed after a real injected fetch failure, but the saved actor error and malformed visible summary need correction.
reasons.grounding: The finding 对方收到信息后仅回复致谢 incorrectly assigns the right-side 我 acknowledgement to the other party. The same output summary correctly says 我方回复, creating an internal contradiction. Current official and historical sources remain properly distinguished and the namesake is excluded.
reasons.naturalness: The actual output.summary contains literal backslash-n sequences rather than paragraph breaks, and is long and repetitive. The Web card renders the summary as ordinary text, so these escapes are visible. This assessment uses product output, not the separate SDK final prose.
reasons.recovery: The official source fetch returned CONTROLLED_FETCH_TIMEOUT; the agent fetched the historical source, retried the same official source ID successfully, then cited the fetched official source in stored fields. It also corrected CONTACT_CITATION_EXCERPT_MISMATCH before update/finish. This is observed recovery within the controlled adapter boundary.

findings.title: Incorrect actor in saved no-action findings
findings.description: m3 is visibly labelled 我 in the image, but the saved findings label it 对方. The inference label does not cure an actor contradiction.
findings.recommendation: Preserve explicit source-side attribution in generated findings; when actor identity is uncertain, use the visible side/quote rather than an unsupported 我方 or 对方 assignment. Add a regression for the exact left/right case and keep these failed quality trials.

findings.title: Literal newline escapes in product summary
findings.description: The summary contains literal backslash-n escapes that the current plain-text product renderer will show.
findings.recommendation: Generate real paragraph breaks or reject and repair malformed summary formatting before committing. Verify the actual summary field rather than using the SDK prose as a display proxy.

limitations: The noConfirmedOverwrite execution check counts an initially empty confirmed_states table; it establishes no confirmed-state creation in these runs, not preservation of a seeded pre-existing confirmed profile.

Search/fetch identity, dates and failure recovery are tested against explicitly synthetic controlled source responses. They do not establish production Exa availability, live search recall, real site authority or network recovery.
All three trials encountered real tool errors, so recovery is scored. Trial 3 alone exercised the injected fetch timeout.
Earlier attempts remain separate and are not replaced by this assessment. No safety threshold was lowered and no recovery score compensates for a failed grounding or naturalness dimension.
